contexts.text: Truths are like bulwarks within which is good; the bulwarks are assaulted through falsity...

Peace be within thy walls, and rest in thy palaces () = in the exterior man and in the interior; for the exterior man, with the things which are therein... is like a bulwark or fortification for the interior man... Hence the exteriors of man are signified by a bulwark; and his interiors by palaces.
To set the heart to the bulwark () = to love the exterior truths which defend that Church against falsities.
